title: Root cause: scalar Add collapses ZeroMatrix+ZeroMatrix to scalar Zero; dense _eval_matrix_mul (dense.py:198) uses Add(*vec) on block entries, so zero blocks become non-matrix scalars in the blocks grid; second _blockmul then hits 'Zero' object has no attribute 'cols'
evidence_refs: run: flatten([z,z]) -> ([], [0,0], None); Add(z,z) -> scalar Zero; Add(a*a, z*z) -> a**2; modern 1.14 Add(z,z) -> ZeroMatrix

title: Fixed: BlockMatrix with ZeroMatrix blocks now multiplies repeatedly (upstream fix a35bcc4559: MatAdd postprocessor skips scalar S.Zero insertion)
evidence_refs: run: block_collapse(b*b*b) and b._blockmul(b)._blockmul(b) now return a**3 matrix instead of AttributeError; b*b*b*b also works

title: Verified: 86/86 matrix-expressions tests pass with fix; full sympy/matrices suite 476 passed with only pre-existing failures (identical without fix, numpy-2.5-vs-2019 issues)
